crossRefs.note: We, the priests, the Levites, and the people, cast lots for the wood offering, to bring it into the house of our God…
Remember me, my God, concerning this, and don’t wipe out my good deeds that I have done for the house of my God, and…
I commanded the Levites that they should purify themselves, and that they should come and keep the gates, to sanctify…
Don’t remember the sins of my youth, nor my transgressions. Remember me according to your loving kindness, for your…
Yahweh, I love the habitation of your house, the place where your glory dwells.
Don’t gather my soul with sinners, nor my life with bloodthirsty men;
Remember me, Yahweh, with the favor that you show to your people. Visit me with your salvation,
He said to Jesus, “Lord, remember me when you come into your Kingdom.”

translations.web: and for the wood offering, at times appointed, and for the first fruits. Remember me, my God, for good.
translations.bsb: I also arranged for contributions of wood at the appointed times, and for the firstfruits. Remember me, O my God, with favor.
translations.kjv: And for the wood offering, at times appointed, and for the firstfruits. Remember me, O my God, for good.
translations.asv: and for the wood-offering, at times appointed, and for the first-fruits. Remember me, O my God, for good.
